metadata.role: province frames for the country view and the จังหวัด drill-down — context, not an administrative authority
metadata.source: OpenGISData-Thailand provinces.geojson (chingchai/OpenGISData-Thailand), boundaries credited by the publisher to the Department of Provincial Administration (DOPA)
metadata.attribution: ขอบเขตจังหวัด: OpenGISData-Thailand (CC BY 4.0), อ้างอิงกรมการปกครอง
metadata.processing: provinces that hold at least one outlet row of data/camera.json only (matched to js/model.js PROVINCES by Thai name); coordinates rounded to 5 decimals (rings that collapse below 4 positions after rounding are dropped); no simplification, geometry otherwise unchanged; id = production province code, dopaCode = DOPA two-digit code
